content.title: Where to watch Pistons vs. Thunder NBA game free tonight during NBC and FuboTV dispute
content.text: Updated: Mar. 30, 2026, 6:00 p.m.Published: Mar. 30, 2026, 6:00 p.m.DETROIT, MICHIGAN - JANUARY 28: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander #2 of the Oklahoma City Thunder dribbles the ball against Jalen Duren #0 of the Detroit Pistons in the first quarter of a game at Little Caesars Arena on January 28, 2024 in Detroit, Michigan. (Photo by Mike Mulholland/Getty Images)Getty ImagesIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Dustin Hockensmith | dhockensmith@pennlive.comThe best teams from the NBA’s Eastern and Western conferences do battle Monday night in Oklahoma City, where the defending NBA champion Thunder will host the Detroit Pistons. The game is scheduled to start at 9:30 p.m. ET (8:30 p.m. CT) with TV coverage on NBC Sports Now and streaming on-demand.NBC Sports NOW is part of the NBC Universal family of networks currently blacked out on FuboTV during ongoing contract negotiations. Available streaming alternatives are listed below.How to watch Pistons vs. Thunder on TV and stream without cable:When: Monday, March 30 at 9:30 p.m. ET (8:30 p.m. CT) Where: Paycom Center, Oklahoma City, Okla.TV channel: NBC Sports NOW and PeacockStreaming on: DirecTV (free trial) | SlingTV (low intro rate) | Peacock ($10.99+/mo.)Pistons vs. Thunder: The matchupThe Thunder are an NBA-leading 59-16 with seven regular-season remaining games to maintain a 2.5-game lead over the San Antonio Spurs at the top of the Western Conference. Oklahoma City claims the NBA’s No.1 scoring defense (107.6 ppg) and top scoring differential (+11.1) while sprinting toward the playoffs by going 14-1 over its past 15 games. The Thunder are big 13.5-point favorites over Detroit to extend that hot streak and inch closer to the West’s No. 1 seed.The Pistons have gotten back on steady ground since losing four straight games for the first time all season, going 9-2 in 11 games since. Detroit has been so good for so long this season that the team had lost two straight games only twice all season prior to the four-game skid, building a lead at the top of the East standings that now rests at four games over the Boston Celtics.Pistons vs. Thunder: Know your live streamsDirecTV (free trial): DirecTV offers a 5-day free trial and a total of $30 off over the first three full months for the Choice Package, which includes 125-plus channels and access to ESPN Unlimited, a $29.99 standalone value featuring all ESPN channels and ESPN+.SlingTV (low intro rate): First full month of streaming runs as low as $29.99 with current offer for 50% off Sling’s Orange & Blue Plan. Day passes are also available for 24 hours ($4.99), as well as three-day ($9.99) and seven-day access ($14.99).Peacock ($10.99+/mo.): Peacock’s library of live sports is growing and features exclusive NFL and college football games, all in addition to NBC Universal movies, television series, and more.TOP STREAMING PICKSBY PENNLIVE.COM
